name: divinci-app-funnel
description: divinci.app funnel — deploy via these scripts so the pinned-asset guard always runs

scripts.deploy: node check-pinned-assets.mjs && node check-funnel-integrity.mjs && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --env='' && node check-pinned-assets.mjs --live && node check-funnel-integrity.mjs --live
scripts.deploy:staging: node check-pinned-assets.mjs && node check-funnel-integrity.mjs && env -u CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN wrangler deploy --env staging
